IKEA was obviously aware of the horrible wood quality they changed one of the fastening parts to plastic so that the materials have a better chance to stay intact. They also took me significantly longer to build because nothing fit together easily. Since I have so many already for my project I need to keep what I have. review.reviewBody:
I purchased the Storklinta 3-drawer dresser because my bedroom desperately needed some extra storage—and, honestly, a little life. The room felt so barren and unfinished, and this simple piece ended up making a bigger difference than I expected.

Assembly was surprisingly easy, the clean and simple design is beautiful, and the drawers are a great size for holding everything I needed. It adds just the right amount of warmth and functionality without overwhelming the room.

review.name: Disappointing
review.reviewBody:
I gave this chest of drawers 3 stars because I got it put together. It looks okay, and the drawers work. The workmanship was poor, however. Specific problems included: (1) a drawer bottom so warped that I had trouble fitting it into the grooves in the front and back of the drawer. Squaring it up with the drawer rails helped, but the drawer is not as solid as it should be; (2) 2 out of 3 drawer backs with defective holes for the drawer support bracket. One was missing a hole, which had to be drilled. The other had a hole so close the groove that the metal bracket broke through when hammered in; and (3) holes in the bottom board of the case that did not line up with the holes in the backing board.

The glass top was also a shock. I had been told in the store that it came with glass spacers. Instead it came with 3 holes along one edge and ugly metal brackets to attach it to the chest. 

We were considering buying other IKEA pieces but will not do so after this experience.

The upholstery is poorly finished. It took 3 purchases to get a decent looking chair—poly stuffing sticking out on the bottom seam, misaligned holes for assembly, and lumpy cushions. I kept the third chair but had to use a lumbar pillow to cover the lumpy looking cushion.

review.name: Beautiful
review.reviewBody: Looks great, comfortable. Highly recommend

review.name: Very nice!
review.reviewBody: This is a very comfortable and very sturdy.  I have had this chair for about 8 months. I'm 6'2" and weigh 200 pounds and it works for me.  I use it to read and watch TV. I'm very happy with this product.

review.name: excellent kitchen seating
review.reviewBody: needed some lounge-y chairs for our kitchen and 2 of these fit the bill nicely. comfy but also sturdy

review.name: Very Comfy Chair
review.reviewBody: Surprisingly comfortable and sturdy.  Deep cushion that is soft, yet supportive.  Looks very high end.

review.name: Mid Century Modern Delight
review.reviewBody: The cushions are a tad firmer than I would prefer but a fantastic chair overall. It was easy to put together, sturdy with a solid wood construction, comfortable to sit in for long periods, and its appearance fits right in with MCM design. I was so pleased with it I got 2 of them

review.name: Love it!
review.reviewBody: It was super easy to assemble and I've the color. The color is calming and not busy. Sometimes IKEA furniture is tricky to assemble. This was so easy it took me ten minutes to assemble. I really love this chair and it is really comfortable. The price is a little much, otherwise it is awesome!

review.name: Nice chair just way overpriced for what you get
review.reviewBody: It’s comfy basic little chair

review.name: Ticks the boxes
review.reviewBody: Ekenaset arm chair ticks all the boxes . Not only is this chair good looking  it’s comfortable , overall support right where you need it . The fabric is seemingly durable. I vacuum furniture the texture hasn’t changed. Easy build , easy to use in any room , not too heavy or large to move .

review.name: Comfortable, classy looking
review.reviewBody: I would highly recommend these chairs. Great price, comfortable, and fit in a smaller room. They are also easy to assemble.

review.name: Stylish chairs
review.reviewBody: Good quality chairs. Reasonable price. Easy assembly.

review.name: Great chair
review.reviewBody: Well built elegant chair. Its fabric matches perfectly with a sofa available in the same fabric. Comfy to sit in.

json_ld.name: Ergonomic Chair Pro
json_ld.description: A new era of ergonomics has arrived. Introducing Ergonomic Chair Pro, an unrivaled seating experience backed by half a decade of research, development, and testing with people who embody a wide variety of support needs and work styles. Designed by Branch in San Francisco, Ergonomic Chair Pro was meticulously (re)designed with the feedback of thousands of customers. It offers better customization, build quality, and materials to support productivity and well-being in the home, workplace, and anywhere work is done.Led by designer Jesse Menayan, we wanted to create a flagship chair that not only matched but improved on the comfort and materiality of chairs that are twice the price. With 14 points of adjustment, an improved headrest, and an optional tall cylinder, Ergonomic Chair Pro offers superlative adjustability to fit every body. A choice of luxurious materials completes your daily sit, including super soft performance mesh, textured bouclé, durable vegan leather, or semi-aniline leather. Ergonomic Chair Pro is the culmination of our commitment to democratizing comfort and productivity in the workplace.

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between the Ergonomic Chair and the Ergonomic Chair Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ergonomic Chair Pro offers more adjustments, upgraded lumbar support, and premium material options. It’s designed for all-day comfort with added customization and enhanced support.

mainEntity.name: Do ergonomic chairs help with back or posture issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ergonomic chairs feature adjustment points that support proper seated posture. The Ergonomic Chair Pro includes padded lumbar support and customizable armrests, so you can fine-tune your setup.

mainEntity.name: Is a mesh or cushion chair better for long sitting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mesh and cushion chairs both offer ergonomic support. Mesh is breathable and helps regulate temperature, while cushions provide a softer seat. The Ergonomic Chair Pro offers a breathable mesh back with a comfortable cushion seat.

mainEntity.name: What materials are used in the Ergonomic Chair Pro’s construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ergonomic Chair Pro is made with a powder-coated aluminum base, high-density foam cushioning, and your choice of fine-weave mesh, vegan leather, or premium leather upholstery.

mainEntity.name: What is the weight capacity of the Ergonomic Chair Pro?

json_ld.name: Verve Chair
json_ld.description: We set out to create a chair that establishes a new industry standard for design and comfort but costs half the price of its peers. Designed in California and winner of an iF Design Award, Verve is masterfully conceived and obsessively engineered with particular emphasis on an inviting aesthetic and exceptional ergonomics and value.Wrapped in a unique 3D knit, its V-shaped suspended back offers integrated and adjustable spine support for continuous comfort. Precise color matching across materials produces a truly unified palette that enables anyone to create eye-catching sightlines in the home or workplace.

mainEntity.name: How do I compare Verve vs the Ergonomic Chair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both offer comprehensive ergonomic support. The Ergonomic Chair is our bestselling option for everyday comfort, while Verve pairs premium materials with a more elevated, design-forward look.

mainEntity.name: What makes a chair good for shorter individuals?

acceptedAnswer.text: A chair with a shorter seat and broader height range supports shorter individuals by promoting proper posture and allowing feet to rest comfortably and flat on the floor.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between ergonomic and regular office chairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: An ergonomic chair promotes healthy posture with adjustable lumbar support, armrests, seat height, and depth. It is ideal for long hours working at a desk.

mainEntity.name: What materials is the Verve Chair made of and is it durable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Verve features a reinforced polyamide frame, aluminum base, breathable 3D-knit back, and high-density foam seat. It meets BIFMA standards and comes with a 7-year warranty.
